        const name=npc.bossMoveIndex%2?'cannon':'artillery';
        if(name==='cannon')npc.facing=player.x<npc.x?'left':'right';
        begin(npc,name,name==='cannon'?{angle:npc.facing==='left'?Math.PI:0}:{});
        npc.attack={name,facing:npc.facing||'left',elapsed:0,walkElapsed:npc.elapsed||0};

      if(npc.type==='neru')begin(npc,npc.bossMoveIndex%2?'shoot':'compress',npc.bossMoveIndex%2?{clip:'shoot',nextBullet:0}:{});

      const cannon=action.name==='cannon',windup=cannon?s.cannonWindupSeconds:.4;

/** Select a direction-specific walking cycle, or hold frame zero when idle. */
function getAnimationFrame(character) {
  if (character.attack) {
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    return Math.min(character.layout.columnEdges.length - 2,
      Math.floor(character.attack.elapsed / attack.frameDuration));
  }
  if (!character.moving) return 0;
  const frames = character.walkFrames?.[character.direction] ||
    character.frameSequence || [1, 2, 3, 4];
  const duration = character.frameDuration || frameDuration;
  return frames[Math.floor(character.elapsed / duration) % frames.length];
}

/** Blend from the last visible pose without moving the character's world anchor. */
function beginPoseTransition(character) {
  if (character.transitionDuration && character.lastPose) {
    character.transition = { from: character.lastPose, elapsed: 0 };
  }

import { drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js?plasma-orange=2';
import { arisuBodyCenterOffsetY } from './game-config.js';
import { bossBehaviorSettings as settings, contactSettings } from './game-config.js';

import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Fire horizontally only when the player overlaps or is moving into the barrel lane. */
export function irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
  const s=settings.iroha,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),barrelY=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY;
  const predictedY=body.y+(delta>0?(motion.y||0)/delta*s.cannonPredictionSeconds:0);
  const clearance=s.cannonWarningWidth/2+body.ry;
  const enters=Math.min(body.y,predictedY)<=barrelY+clearance&&Math.max(body.y,predictedY)>=barrelY-clearance;
  const dx=Math.abs(body.x-npc.x),dy=Math.abs(body.y-barrelY);
  return enters&&dx>=dy?'cannon':'artillery';
}

/** Boss action state, projectiles and warned area attacks; Shiroko keeps ordinary chase AI. */
export function createBossBehaviors() {
  const bullets=[],zones=[],warnings=new Map();
  function hit(player,amount) {
    if(player.contactIFrames>0)return;
    if(damagePlayer(player,amount))player.contactIFrames=contactSettings.iFrameDuration;
  }
  function fire(npc,angle,speed,radius=5,options={}) {
    if(bullets.length>=settings.projectileLimit)return;
    bullets.push({owner:npc.id,x:npc.x,y:npc.y,previousX:npc.x,previousY:npc.y,
      vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,radius,age:0,damage:npc.contactDamage||1,...options});
  }
  function zone(npc,x,y,delay,radius) { zones.push({owner:npc.id,x,y,remaining:delay,radius,damage:npc.contactDamage||1}); }
  function begin(npc,name,extra={}) { npc.bossAction={name,elapsed:0,...extra};npc.gifElapsed=0;npc.moving=false; }
  function finish(npc) {npc.bossAction=null;npc.bossSquash=1;npc.bossVisualOffsetY=0;npc.attack=null;}
  /** Return true while this controller owns movement; otherwise use ordinary chasing. */

import { drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js?plasma-orange=2';
import { arisuBodyCenterOffsetY } from './game-config.js';
import { bossBehaviorSettings as settings, contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Position-based pool, recalculated once when Iroha starts an attack. */
export function irohaAttackChances(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
  const s=settings.iroha,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
  const dx=Math.abs(player.x-npc.x),dy=Math.abs(player.y-npc.y);
  if(dy<1e-6)return {cannon:1,artillery:0};
  const barrelY=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,clearance=s.cannonWarningWidth/2+body.ry;
  const predictedY=body.y+(delta>0?(motion.y||0)/delta*s.cannonPredictionSeconds:0);
  const enters=Math.min(body.y,predictedY)<=barrelY+clearance&&Math.max(body.y,predictedY)>=barrelY-clearance;
  const alignment=Math.min(dy,Math.abs(body.y-barrelY));
  let cannon=dx/(dx+dy)*Math.max(0,1-alignment/clearance);
  if(enters&&Math.abs(predictedY-barrelY)<Math.abs(body.y-barrelY))cannon=Math.max(cannon,.75*dx/(dx+dy));
  cannon=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,cannon));
  return {cannon,artillery:1-cannon};
}
export function irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0},random=Math.random) {
  const pool=irohaAttackChances(npc,player,delta,motion);
  return random()<pool.cannon?'cannon':'artillery';
}

import { drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js?plasma-orange=2';
import { arisuBodyCenterOffsetY } from './game-config.js';
import { bossBehaviorSettings as settings, contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Solve horizontal shell interception, including windup, travel time and player velocity. */
export function irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
  const s=settings.iroha,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
  const vx=delta>0?(motion.x||0)/delta:0,vy=delta>0?(motion.y||0)/delta:0;
  const barrelY=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,clearance=s.cannonWarningWidth/2+body.ry;
  const earliest=s.cannonWindupSeconds+s.cannonFireDelay;
  const options=[];
  for(const side of [-1,1]) {
    const muzzle=npc.x+side*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35;
    const relativeSpeed=side*s.cannonSpeed-vx;
    if(Math.abs(relativeSpeed)>1e-8) {
      const impactTime=(body.x-muzzle+side*s.cannonSpeed*earliest)/relativeSpeed;
      if(impactTime>=earliest&&impactTime-earliest<=settings.projectileLifetime&&Math.abs(body.y+vy*impactTime-barrelY)<=clearance)
        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt:earliest,impactTime});
    }
    if(Math.abs(vy)>1e-8) {
      const impactTime=(barrelY-body.y)/vy;
      const flight=(body.x+vx*impactTime-muzzle)/(side*s.cannonSpeed);
      const fireAt=impactTime-flight;
      if(flight>=0&&flight<=settings.projectileLifetime&&fireAt>=earliest&&fireAt<=earliest+s.cannonMaxInterceptWait)
        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt,impactTime});
    }
  }
  return options.sort((a,b)=>a.fireAt-b.fireAt||a.impactTime-b.impactTime)[0]||null;
}

/** Position-based pool, recalculated once when Iroha starts an attack. */
export function irohaAttackChances(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
  const s=settings.iroha,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
  const dx=Math.abs(player.x-npc.x),dy=Math.abs(player.y-npc.y);
  const intercept=irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion);
  if(!intercept)return {cannon:0,artillery:1};
  if(dy<1e-6)return {cannon:1,artillery:0};
  const barrelY=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,clearance=s.cannonWarningWidth/2+body.ry;
  const predictedY=body.y+(delta>0?(motion.y||0)/delta*s.cannonPredictionSeconds:0);
  const enters=Math.min(body.y,predictedY)<=barrelY+clearance&&Math.max(body.y,predictedY)>=barrelY-clearance;
  const alignment=Math.min(dy,Math.abs(body.y-barrelY));
  let cannon=dx/(dx+dy)*Math.max(0,1-alignment/clearance);
  if(enters&&Math.abs(predictedY-barrelY)<Math.abs(body.y-barrelY))cannon=Math.max(cannon,.75*dx/(dx+dy));
  if(intercept.fireAt>s.cannonWindupSeconds+s.cannonFireDelay)cannon=Math.max(cannon,.75*dx/(dx+dy));
  cannon=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,cannon));
  return {cannon,artillery:1-cannon};
}
export function irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0},random=Math.random) {
  const pool=irohaAttackChances(npc,player,delta,motion);
  return random()<pool.cannon?'cannon':'artillery';
}

/** Boss action state, projectiles and warned area attacks; Shiroko keeps ordinary chase AI. */
export function createBossBehaviors({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const bullets=[],zones=[],warnings=new Map();
  function hit(player,amount) {
    if(player.contactIFrames>0)return false;
    if(damagePlayer(player,amount)){player.contactIFrames=contactSettings.iFrameDuration;return true;}
    return false;
  }
  function fire(npc,angle,speed,radius=5,options={}) {
    if(bullets.length>=settings.projectileLimit)return;
    bullets.push({owner:npc.id,x:npc.x,y:npc.y,previousX:npc.x,previousY:npc.y,
      vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,radius,age:0,damage:npc.contactDamage||1,...options});
  }
  function zone(npc,x,y,delay,radius) { zones.push({owner:npc.id,x,y,remaining:delay,radius,damage:npc.contactDamage||1}); }
  function begin(npc,name,extra={}) { npc.bossAction={name,elapsed:0,...extra};npc.gifElapsed=0;npc.moving=false; }
  function finish(npc) {npc.bossAction=null;npc.bossSquash=1;npc.bossVisualOffsetY=0;npc.attack=null;}
  /** Return true while this controller owns movement; otherwise use ordinary chasing. */
  function updateNpc(npc,player,delta,viewport,playerMotion={x:0,y:0}) {
    const s=settings[npc.type];
    if(!s||!npc.ai||delta<=0)return false;
    npc.bossCooldown=(npc.bossCooldown??s.interval)-delta;
    if(!npc.bossAction&&npc.bossCooldown<=0) {
      npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;npc.bossMoveIndex=(npc.bossMoveIndex||0)+1;
      if(npc.type==='arisu')begin(npc,'chargeUp',{clip:'charge',angle:Math.atan2(player.y-npc.y,player.x-npc.x)});
      if(npc.type==='iroha') {
        const name=irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,playerMotion,random);
        const intercept=name==='cannon'?irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,playerMotion):null;
        if(intercept)npc.facing=Math.cos(intercept.angle)<0?'left':'right';
        begin(npc,name,intercept||{});
        npc.attack={name,facing:npc.facing||'left',elapsed:0,walkElapsed:npc.elapsed||0};
      }
      if(npc.type==='neru')begin(npc,npc.bossMoveIndex%2?'shoot':'compress',npc.bossMoveIndex%2?{clip:'shoot',nextBullet:0}:{});
    }
    const action=npc.bossAction;if(!action)return false;
    action.elapsed+=delta;npc.moving=false;
    if(action.name==='chargeUp') {
      const center={x:npc.x+(npc.spriteHurtbox?.offsetX||0),y:npc.y+arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc)};
      if(!action.aimLocked) {
        action.angle=Math.atan2(player.y-center.y,player.x-center.x);
        action.targetX=player.x;action.targetY=player.y;
        if(action.elapsed>=s.trackingSeconds-1e-8)action.aimLocked=true;
      }
      npc.facing=Math.cos(action.angle)<0?'left':'right';
      warnings.set(npc.id,{x:center.x,y:center.y,angle:action.angle,progress:Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.chargeUpSeconds),length:Math.hypot(viewport.width,viewport.height)+npc.spriteSize,width:s.warningWidth});
    }

### UI mockups

For requests to design, preview, or explore a product interfaceâ€”including a standalone dialog, card, or controlâ€”read [mockups.md](mockups.md) for product styling, variant carousels, and design controls.

### Built-in widgets

Use these prebuilt widgets when they fit the data. Read the corresponding guide:

- Calendar (`widgets/calendar.md`): day, week, and month schedules.
- Waterfall (`widgets/waterfall.md`): timed request spans.
- Flame chart (`widgets/flamechart.md`): sampled CPU stacks.
- Stack trace (`widgets/stacktrace.md`): error call stacks.

### Interactive explainer or simulation

- Use compact controls or status, one compact dominant visual, and at most one single-line selected-state detail. Default to no summary cards; allow up to three only when changing metrics are central.
- Crop empty space and fit the available inline width. For step-throughs, add only requested step controls and update one current visual; never add parameter controls, formulas, metric cards, or side-by-side steps unless asked.

### Maps

For geographic maps, including maps within another visualization, read [maps.md](maps.md) for sourced geometry, projection, and map-specific validation.

### Dense categorical grid

- Use one compact horizontal selected-item summary, then a grid with exactly one readable identifier per cell, then one small legend. Render only that identifier as visible cell text; put all other metadata in an accessible label or one summary line, not badges or fact grids. Allow only selection unless asked.

### Part-to-whole or time allocation

- Use compact metrics and one stacked chart of category allocation per period. Never substitute totals-only bars or duplicate it as a heatmap and totals chart.

### Illustrated overviews

- For a walkthrough of successive screens, draw one illustrated HTML/SVG overview. Show all the named screens together, connect their sketches in order, and mark the cue that identifies each step. For a question about how a visible field changes, use the illustrated HTML/SVG overview to show its before and after values on one recognizable screen or record. Use the same view to show how parts fit or to mark a matching or changed field on each record. Read `<skill-dir>/technical-illustrations.md` for the drawing style.

## Layout and accessibility

- Use semantic HTML, keyboard-accessible controls, and concise labels.
- Use `aria-live="polite"` for dynamic results, selections, and simulator updates. Use `role="alert"` for validation errors. Do not announce every hover or animation frame.
- Keep the top-level surface transparent and unframed, and fill the available conversation width. Design for 736px, or 1,024px in wide mode, and support widths down to 320px. Stack side-by-side content when it no longer fits.
- At every supported width, text, controls, cards, toolbars, and dynamic content must fit without overlap or clipping. Reflow by stacking or wrapping; use `.table-responsive` only when table columns cannot fit. The host sizes the frame to its content, so avoid fixed outer widths, other horizontal overflow, internal scrolling, `position: fixed`, and viewport-height layouts.
- Size every SVG from its actual container. At narrow widths, reduce ticks, declutter annotations, and keep visible text at least 11 screen pixels; never shrink a fixed-width `viewBox`.
- Keep native tab order; never add `tabindex`.
- Use native `button`, `input`, `select`, and `textarea` elements with matching utilities; never recreate controls.
- Keep browser or utility focus styles; never override them.
- On coarse pointers, provide non-overlapping effective targets about 44px by 44px without breaking 320px layouts; visible icons and marks may stay small. Keep fine-pointer controls compact, and let shared utilities own touch sizing and at least 16px editable-field text.
- Keep essential content and actions available without hover.
- Try to keep 90Ã—50px clear for host controls (top-right in LTR hosts, top-left in RTL hosts).

## Design system

- Let utilities own geometry, appearance, and interaction. Use the matching utility for every button and form control. Never restyle utilities, descendants, or pseudo-elements: no custom sizes, spacing, borders, radii, shadows, colors, or interaction states.

### Surfaces and layout

- `.card`: The only card-like HTML surface. Use its base class unchanged for a necessary numeric summary, selected-item summary, or bounded interactive field. Before adding a fill, border, radius, or shadow to any layout container, either use `.card` or leave it transparent and unframed; never recreate card chrome on rows, panels, tiles, sections, or wrappers. Keep charts, maps, diagrams, tables, controls, and the whole visualization unframed. Never nest cards; show 2-4 summaries near the top only when useful. Structural groupings and repeated content are not bounded interactive fields. Organize them with layout or visual marks, not container chrome.
- `.viz-stat`: Use a summary `.card` with one muted label, one `.viz-stat-value`, and at most one short context or delta line.
- `.viz-grid`: Use for peer metrics or choices instead of a custom grid. It creates as many equal-width columns as fit and stacks when narrow. Never use it for the whole visual or a horizontally scrolling card row. Keep groups to 2-3 columns at 736px and controls in a separate row.
- `.viz-row`: Use as a wrapping horizontal group with centered related values or inline actions that may wrap when narrow.
- `<hr>`: Use a native horizontal rule for a subtle theme-aware separator.
- `.nav.nav-pills` + `.nav-link`: Use the accessible, interactive [Tabs](#tabs) API below.
- `.progress` + `.progress-bar`: `<div class="progress" role="progressbar" aria-label="Progress" aria-valuenow="25" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"><div class="progress-bar" style="width:25%"></div></div>`
- `.viz-tile`: Add to a selectable dense-grid `.btn`; it stretches to fill its grid cell, preserves category fill, and uses an accent ring instead of solid selection. Never add another selected, pressed, border, outline, or shadow rule.
- `.viz-badge`: Use as a compact display-only accent pill for a short status, category, or value; never as a button.
- `.viz-controls`: Use as a wrapping row for controls affecting the same visualization. Keep button groups compact. Put labeled fields directly inside as `.form-label`; fields form at most two columns and stack when narrow.

### Tabs

- `.nav.nav-pills[role="tablist"]`: Group content-width native `.nav-link[role="tab"]` buttons and label the group with `aria-label`. Add `.nav-justified` only when tabs should share and fill the row equally.
- `.nav-link[role="tab"]`: Give each button a unique `id`, `type="button"`, `aria-controls`, and `aria-selected`. Mark the initial tab `.active` and `aria-selected="true"`; use `disabled` or `aria-disabled="true"` when needed.
- `[role="tabpanel"]`: Match `id` to its tab's `aria-controls`, set `aria-labelledby` to the tab's `id`, and mark inactive panels `hidden`. Tabs can have separate panels or point to one shared panel.
- Tab behavior is already implemented by the JavaScript runtime and does not need to be wired.

```html
<div class="nav nav-pills" role="tablist" aria-label="Platform">
  <button
    class="nav-link active"
    id="mac"
    role="tab"
    aria-controls="mac-panel"
    aria-selected="true"
    type="button"
  >
    macOS
  </button>
  <button
    class="nav-link"
    id="linux"
    role="tab"
    aria-controls="linux-panel"
    aria-selected="false"
    type="button"
  >
    Linux
  </button>
</div>
<div id="mac-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="mac">macOS content</div>
<div id="linux-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="linux" hidden>
  Linux content
</div>
```

### Controls

- Use `.cursor-interaction` on custom interactive elements, including locally styled widget controls. It follows the host cursor preference; never hardcode `cursor:pointer`. Shared controls already apply it. Preserve text, drag and disabled cursors for those states.

- Place related inputs and buttons on one row, aligned at their vertical centers. Put labels and values on a separate row above them.
- `.btn`: Use for a content-sized secondary action. Add `.btn-primary` for one main action per control group or `.btn-ghost` for low emphasis.
- `.btn-block`: Add to a `.btn` only when the action should intentionally fill the available inline space. Never use it for ordinary row actions.
- `<a>`: Use for links. Add `.btn` to style a link as a button.
- `[data-tooltip]`: Use for concise supplementary plain text on static or dynamic triggers; the sandbox handles hover, focus, and touch and creates `.tooltip` elements. Keep essential content visible and triggers labeled. Never use `title`, custom markup, or initialization. Example: `<button type="button" data-tooltip="Reset view">Reset</button>`.
- When a visible label is truncated, put its full text in `data-tooltip` on the existing accessible trigger so hover, focus, and tap reveal it.
- `[data-tooltip-placement]`: Optionally prefer `top` (default), `right`, `bottom`, or `left`; collision handling may flip it.
- `.form-check`: Prefer a wrapping `<label class="form-check">` around the native `.form-check-input` and `.form-check-label` text so the whole row is tappable. An explicit label with matching `for` and input `id` also works.
- `.form-switch`: Add to `.form-check` around a native checkbox.
- `.form-control`: Pair a native text, date, file, or color inputâ€”or a textareaâ€”with `.form-label`.
- `.form-control-color`: Add to `.form-control` for a compact native color input.
- `.form-select`: Pair a native select with `.form-label`.
- `.form-range`: Pair a native range with a visible label; put its current value and units immediately before it.

### Tables

- `.table`: Use on a semantic table for a quiet, unframed data view. It provides wrapping cells and subtle horizontal dividers without vertical gridlines. Use sentence case for headers.
- `.table-responsive`: Wrap a table when its columns cannot fit at narrow widths. It contains horizontal overflow without clipping the visualization.
- `.table-sm`: Add to `.table` when more rows need to fit; it reduces cell padding without shrinking text.
- `.text-end`, `.text-center`, and `.text-nowrap`: Use inside `.table` for numeric/end alignment, centered values, or values that must stay on one line. Numeric cells use tabular figures when end-aligned.

### Text

- `.text-small`: Use for the smallest host-scaled secondary chart labels and annotations, never below 11px or for essential content.
- `.text-muted`: Use for secondary units, captions, timestamps, and context, never essential values or labels.
- `.text-destructive`: Use only for error or validation text the user needs to notice or act on.
- `<code>`: Use for inline commands, file names, symbols, or short references; put multiline code in `<pre><code>`.
- `.sr-only`: Use for visually hidden accessible text.

## Charts

**General Instructions:**

- Resolve theme colors before passing them to canvas or chart APIs that cannot parse CSS variables or `light-dark(...)`; redraw when the theme changes.
- Use a tooltip unless it would distract from a simple, directly labeled chart. Keep chart-library tooltips and grouped legend interactions native; never replace them with a custom one-point tooltip.
- Animate transitions between chart states so lines and marks move to their new values, resampling paths when point counts differ. Do not animate initial appearance or use fade-only effects; never loop motion, and honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Include labeled axes, units, and directly labeled important values. Give every chart, SVG, canvas, and widget a concise screen-reader summary using a role and accessible name or description, SVG `<title>`/`<desc>`, fallback text, or an `.sr-only` heading or description.
- Format calendar-year ticks as whole years without digit grouping (e.g. `1920`). Keep the time scale proportional when observations are unevenly spaced.
- Reserve space for the longest formatted label at every supported width. Axis ticks are secondary and may use `.text-small` when space is tight. Never overlap or clip text against marks, axes, legends, labels, or edges; move or reduce labels rather than squeeze them.
- Add a legend only when multiple series cannot be labeled directly.
- Pair color with shape or text so meaning never depends on color alone.

For standard chart components, the selected family and shared contract govern rendering, composition and validation, taking precedence over general guidance for this chart artifact only, including its surrounding text, tables and controls. A chart composition may include a short analytical summary and an exact-values table. ### Fallback chart rendering

- Prefer inline SVG for simple charts and version-pinned approved-CDN libraries when native interaction, scales, legends, or layout materially improve the result.
- Prefer `<line>` for straight SVG axis, tick and connector segments. Explicitly set `fill="none"` on stroke-only `<path>` or `<polyline>` axes and leader lines: SVG fills open paths by implicitly closing them, so an L-shaped axis can otherwise become a filled triangle. Scope this to stroke-only geometry; preserve intentional fills on area bands, filled markers and other chart shapes.
- For a custom chart, check its data, calculations and geometry offline. Use an available preview only to diagnose concrete rendering or interaction breakage, or for explicitly requested testing. If rendering was not inspected, do not claim it was verified.
- For SVG, attach `data-tooltip` directly to the real pointer-accessible mark and include its label, value, and units; the sandbox handles themed positioning, keyboard focus, and touch.
- Keep decorative SVG fills, bands and leader lines from intercepting interactive marks (`pointer-events: none`). When observations overlap, use a grouped tooltip or series selection/focus so every observation remains inspectable; do not rely on tiny exposed edges. When a preview is needed under the validation policy, inspect an overlapping observation in the primary interaction.
- Scope SVG styles to the chart class. Never target every `svg` in a container that also contains Lucide icons.

## Icons and mockups

- Use the sandbox-provided global `lucide`. Add an icon name with `data-lucide`:

  ```html
  <i data-lucide="search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
  ```

- Never author inline icon SVG or icon paths. Use only supplied Lucide names; the sandbox replaces each placeholder with a host-sized `currentColor` SVG. Reserve authored inline SVG for charts and data marks.
- Mark decorative icons `aria-hidden="true"`. Put action icons inside labeled controls; use a visible label or `aria-label` for icon-only actions.
- Let the sandbox initialize static icons after the fragment without blocking first render. After adding icons dynamically, use `lucide.createIcons({ attrs: { width: 16, height: 16 } })`.
- Never load Lucide or another icon library from the network.
- Use visibly labeled buttons and inputs for small interactions. Keep all presentation-only interaction local to the fragment and make the first render useful before input changes.

import re
import numpy as np
import matplotlib

```text

```

```text
y=(100-x)/(x+1)
```

Should I use this shape even though it replaces the earlier **45° = 50/50** rule?

/** Move within canvas bounds, keeping diagonal and cardinal movement equally fast. */
function updateCharacter(character, delta, direction, chaseTarget) {
  if (character.attack) {
    character.attack.elapsed += delta * 1000;
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    const frames = character.layout.columnEdges.length - 1;
    if (character.attack.elapsed >= frames * attack.frameDuration) {
      const walkElapsed = character.attack.walkElapsed;
      beginPoseTransition(character);
      character.attack = null;
      character.elapsed = walkElapsed;
      updateAttackControls();
    } else {
      return;
    }
  }
  character.moving = Boolean(direction);
  if (!direction) {
    character.elapsed = 0;
    return;
  }

  // Arona turns at the current stride phase rather than snapping to frame zero.
  if (character.direction !== direction && !character.preserveWalkPhase) {
    character.elapsed = 0;
  }
  character.direction = direction;
  if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) {
    const horizontal = directionVectors[direction][0];
    if (horizontal) {
      const facing = horizontal > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
      if (facing !== character.facing) beginPoseTransition(character);
      character.facing = facing;
    }
  }

/** Load predecoded GIF display frames while retaining original frame durations. */
export async function loadGifAnimation(character) {
  character.animationFrames = await Promise.all(character.gifFrames.map(frame =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => resolve({ image, duration: frame.duration });
      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${frame.source}.`));
      image.src = frame.source;
    })
  ));
  character.image = character.animationFrames[0].image;
}

/** Select the original GIF frame for elapsed playback time, including while idle. */
export function gifFrameAt(frames, elapsed) {
  const total = frames.reduce((sum, frame) => sum + frame.duration, 0);
  let time = elapsed % total;
  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    time -= frames[i].duration;
    if (time < 0) return i;
  }
  return 0;
}

/** Cardinal movement produces +; diagonal movement produces X. */
export function irohaArtilleryPoints(npc,player,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
  const dx=Math.abs(motion.x||0),dy=Math.abs(motion.y||0);
  const diagonal=Math.max(dx,dy)>1e-6&&Math.min(dx,dy)/Math.max(dx,dy)>.4;
  const radius=settings.iroha.artillerySpacing,angle=diagonal?Math.PI/4:0;
  return [{x:player.x,y:player.y},...Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>({
    x:player.x+Math.cos(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*radius,y:player.y+Math.sin(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*radius}))];
}

/** Boss action state, projectiles and warned area attacks; Shiroko keeps ordinary chase AI. */
export function createBossBehaviors({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const bullets=[],zones=[],warnings=new Map();
  function hit(player,amount) {
    if(player.contactIFrames>0)return false;
    if(damagePlayer(player,amount)){player.contactIFrames=contactSettings.iFrameDuration;return true;}
      context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,85,100,.65)';context.strokeRect(-back,-half,w.length+back,w.width);
      // Twin inner lines converge on the dash axis as the windup expires.
      const closing=half*(1-w.progress);
      context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,160,165,.85)';context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(-back,-closing);context.lineTo(w.length,-closing);
      context.moveTo(-back,closing);context.lineTo(w.length,closing);context.stroke();
      context.restore();
    }
    for(const z of zones){
      if(z.artillery&&z.age>=settings.iroha.artilleryDelay) {
        const elapsed=z.age-settings.iroha.artilleryDelay;
        if(elapsed<settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds) {
          const t=elapsed/settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds;
          const x=z.x-camera.x+z.side*260*(1-t),y=z.y-camera.y-500*(1-t);
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,178,60,.6)';context.lineWidth=8;context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(x+z.side*35,y-70);context.lineTo(x,y);context.stroke();
          context.fillStyle='#fff0a8';context.beginPath();context.arc(x,y,8,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.lineWidth=2;
        } else drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,z,elapsed-settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds);
        continue;
      }
      context.strokeStyle='#ff5264';context.fillStyle='rgba(255,60,90,.12)';context.beginPath();context.arc(z.x-camera.x,z.y-camera.y,z.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();}
    for(const b of bullets){
      if(b.cannon){drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,{...b,color:'orange'},settings.iroha.cannonWarningWidth/3.6,settings.projectileLifetime);continue;}
      context.fillStyle='#61deff';context.strokeStyle='#e5fcff';context.beginPath();context.arc(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y,b.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();}

    context.restore();
  }
  return {updateNpc,updateEffects,draw,get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get zoneCount(){return zones.length;}};
}

      if(action.elapsed>=(cannon?fireAt+s.cannonSeconds-s.cannonWindupSeconds-s.cannonFireDelay:s.artillerySeconds))finish(npc);
    } else if(action.name==='shoot') {
      while(action.nextBullet<=Math.min(action.elapsed,s.shootSeconds)) {
      context.moveTo(-back,closing);context.lineTo(w.length,closing);context.stroke();
      context.restore();
    }
    for(const z of zones){
      if(z.artillery&&z.age<0)continue;
      if(z.artillery&&z.age>=settings.iroha.artilleryDelay) {
        const elapsed=z.age-settings.iroha.artilleryDelay-(z.impactOffset||0);
        if(elapsed<0)continue;
        if(elapsed<settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds) {
          const t=elapsed/settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds;
          const x=z.x+z.side*260*(1-t),y=z.y-500*(1-t);
          drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,{x,y,angle:Math.atan2(500,-z.side*260),
            speed:Math.hypot(260,500)/settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds,age:elapsed,color:'orange'},
            settings.iroha.cannonWarningWidth/3.6*settings.iroha.artilleryShellScale,Infinity);
        } else drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,z,elapsed-settings.iroha.artilleryFallSeconds);
        continue;
      }
      context.strokeStyle='#ff5264';context.fillStyle='rgba(255,60,90,.12)';context.beginPath();context.arc(z.x-camera.x,z.y-camera.y,z.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();
      if(z.artillery){
        const progress=Math.min(1,z.age/settings.iroha.artilleryDelay);
        context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,180,185,.9)';context.lineWidth=3;context.beginPath();
        context.arc(z.x-camera.x,z.y-camera.y,Math.max(1,z.radius*(1-progress)),0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();context.lineWidth=2;
      }
    }
    for(const b of bullets){
      if(b.cannon){drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,{...b,color:'orange'},settings.iroha.cannonWarningWidth/3.6,settings.projectileLifetime);continue;}
      context.fillStyle='#61deff';context.strokeStyle='#e5fcff';context.beginPath();context.arc(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y,b.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();}

    context.restore();
  }
  return {updateNpc,updateEffects,draw,get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get zoneCount(){return zones.length;}};
}

import { drawArtilleryExplosion, artilleryExplosionDuration } from './artillery-explosion.js';
import { drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js?plasma-orange=2';
import { arisuBodyCenterOffsetY } from './game-config.js';
import { bossBehaviorSettings as settings, contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Solve horizontal shell interception, including windup, travel time and player velocity. */
export function irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
  const s=settings.iroha,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
  const vx=delta>0?(motion.x||0)/delta:0,vy=delta>0?(motion.y||0)/delta:0;
  const barrelY=npc.y+s.cannonOffsetY,clearance=s.cannonWarningWidth/2+body.ry;
  const earliest=s.cannonWindupSeconds+s.cannonFireDelay;
  const options=[];
  for(const side of [-1,1]) {
    const muzzle=npc.x+side*(npc.spriteSize||200)*.35;
    const relativeSpeed=side*s.cannonSpeed-vx;
    if(Math.abs(relativeSpeed)>1e-8) {
      const impactTime=(body.x-muzzle+side*s.cannonSpeed*earliest)/relativeSpeed;
      if(impactTime>=earliest&&impactTime-earliest<=settings.projectileLifetime&&Math.abs(body.y+vy*impactTime-barrelY)<=clearance)
        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt:earliest,impactTime});
    }
    if(Math.abs(vy)>1e-8) {
      const impactTime=(barrelY-body.y)/vy;
      const flight=(body.x+vx*impactTime-muzzle)/(side*s.cannonSpeed);
      const fireAt=impactTime-flight;
      if(flight>=0&&flight<=settings.projectileLifetime&&fireAt>=earliest&&fireAt<=earliest+s.cannonMaxInterceptWait)
        options.push({angle:side<0?Math.PI:0,fireAt,impactTime});
    }
  }
  return options.sort((a,b)=>a.fireAt-b.fireAt||a.impactTime-b.impactTime)[0]||null;
}

/** Position-based pool, recalculated once when Iroha starts an attack. */
export function irohaAttackChances(npc,player) {
  const dx=Math.abs(player.x-npc.x),dy=Math.abs(player.y-npc.y);
  // Symmetric sigmoid over each quadrant: rapid change through 30?60deg, 50/50 at 45deg.
  const position=Math.atan2(dy,dx)/(Math.PI/2),power=settings.iroha.attackAngleExponent;
  const horizontal=(1-position)**power,vertical=position**power;
  const cannon=dx===0&&dy===0?.5:horizontal/(horizontal+vertical);
  return {cannon,artillery:1-cannon};
}
export function irohaAttackChoice(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0},random=Math.random) {
  const pool=irohaAttackChances(npc,player,delta,motion);
  return random()<pool.cannon?'cannon':'artillery';
}

/** Cardinal movement produces +; diagonal movement produces X. */
export function irohaArtilleryPoints(npc,player,motion={x:0,y:0},viewport={width:1280,height:720}) {
  const dx=Math.abs(motion.x||0),dy=Math.abs(motion.y||0);
  const diagonal=Math.max(dx,dy)>1e-6&&Math.min(dx,dy)/Math.max(dx,dy)>.4;
  const s=settings.iroha;
  // Keep a compact cluster of equal circles, with neighboring edges slightly overlapping.
  // Fit the + footprint using the configured coverage of the shorter visible dimension; X is its 45deg rotation.
  const radius=Math.min(viewport.width,viewport.height)*s.artilleryCoverage/(2*(1+s.artilleryCircleSpacing));
  const spacing=radius*s.artilleryCircleSpacing,angle=diagonal?Math.PI/4:0;
  return [{x:player.x,y:player.y,radius},...Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>({
    x:player.x+Math.cos(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*spacing,
    y:player.y+Math.sin(angle+i*Math.PI/2)*spacing,radius}))];
}
